integrity: The initiating full text was inspected at the definition, complete-bipartite value, and the theorem relating the invariant to edge domination; targeted whole-document term searches were also performed. The universal claim is proved directly and was separately stress-tested on all parameters through shore size six.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for complete bipartite graphs with a matching deleted. The proof is analytic; finite enumeration is used only as a boundary stress test. Bibliographic novelty remains subject to the possibility of an older prescribed-edge maximal-matching formulation not surfaced by the searches.
title: Edge-independent dom-saturation has a three-deletion threshold on bicliques
